---
title: "Giotto ST Pipeline Run"
output: html_document
params:
  config: "configs/visium_template.yaml"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)

input_path <- knitr::current_input()
candidate_roots <- unique(c(
  getwd(),
  normalizePath(file.path(dirname(input_path), ".."), mustWork = FALSE)
))
repo_root <- candidate_roots[file.exists(file.path(candidate_roots, "scripts", "run_all.R"))][1]
if (is.na(repo_root)) {
  stop("Could not find repository root containing scripts/run_all.R.")
}
setwd(repo_root)

if (file.exists("renv/activate.R")) {
  source("renv/activate.R")
}

if (!requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package jsonlite is required. Restore the project with renv::restore() first.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("yaml", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package yaml is required. Restore the project with renv::restore() first.")
}
```

## Configuration

```{r config}
config_path <- normalizePath(params$config, mustWork = TRUE)
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_path)
config
```

## Run Pipeline

```{r run-pipeline}
args <- c("scripts/run_all.R", "--config", config_path)
status <- system2("Rscript", args = args)
if (!identical(status, 0L)) {
  stop("Pipeline command failed with exit status ", status)
}
```

## Output Files

```{r outputs}
output_dir <- normalizePath(config$output_dir, mustWork = FALSE)
project_id <- config$project_id

paths <- list(
  run_parameters = file.path(output_dir, "metadata", "run_parameters.json"),
  provenance = file.path(output_dir, "metadata", "provenance.json"),
  session_info = file.path(output_dir, "metadata", "session_info.txt"),
  qc_metrics = file.path(output_dir, "qc", paste0(project_id, "_qc_metrics.csv")),
  clusters = file.path(output_dir, "tables", "clusters.csv"),
  spatial_plot = file.path(output_dir, "plots", paste0(project_id, "_spatial.png")),
  umap_plot = file.path(output_dir, "plots", paste0(project_id, "_umap.png"))
)

data.frame(
  artifact = names(paths),
  path = unlist(paths, use.names = FALSE),
  exists = file.exists(unlist(paths, use.names = FALSE))
)
```

## Publication Provenance

```{r provenance}
if (file.exists(paths$provenance)) {
  provenance <- jsonlite::read_json(paths$provenance, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  provenance
} else {
  warning("No provenance file found at ", paths$provenance)
}
```

## Figures

```{r figures, out.width="48%"}
if (file.exists(paths$spatial_plot)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(paths$spatial_plot)
}
if (file.exists(paths$umap_plot)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(paths$umap_plot)
}
```
